content.short: Dakota is a stablecoin business account for storing money and moving it across bank and blockchain rails.
content.description: Dakota, built by alumni of Coinbase, Square and Airbnb, is a stablecoin-native business banking platform. Its business account lets companies store money in US dollars or stablecoins such as USDC and move it across traditional rails like SWIFT, ACH and Fedwire as well as on-chain, with custody, cross-border payouts and card issuing built in. Dakota targets developers, fintechs and crypto-native businesses that want the speed and reach of stablecoins with the familiarity of a bank account and enterprise APIs. Its Series A was led by CoinFund. By blending on-chain settlement with conventional networks, it works as a modern account without a traditional bank behind it.
